test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 07
subject: general
question:
In NGO Colony, the people are classified into four different groups as given in the following figure: the rectangle represents men, the triangle represents educated, the circle represents urban and the square represents government employees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e39c2a80945402880d6afbd10da1928c3cb8124de0b7288a3d46b761813fff0.png] 

Which one of the following represents the educated men who are NOT urban?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Educated →Triangle

Men → Rectangle

Circle → Urban

So, the educated men who are not urban will be represented by the area of intersection of triangle and rectangle but excluding area of circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da36a78225a2df9efc8c541ca168914852ed886acb937388ac5ca643fefb9b29.png] 

Such area is represented by number 11. Hence, 11 is the correct answer.
